function.name: abrir_app
function.description: Opens an app on the Mac by name.

function.name: fechar_app
function.description: Closes an open app by name.

function.name: pesquisar_web
function.description: Searches the internet for information. Use it when the subject is current, changing, or you're not sure of the fact.

function.name: calcular
function.description: Calculates a math expression exactly. Use it for any arithmetic instead of doing the math in your head. Percentages as division: 15% of 200 is 15/100*200.

function.name: pesquisar_wiki
function.description: Searches the Resident Evil and The Walking Dead wikis. Always call it before answering anything about Resident Evil or The Walking Dead (characters, games, episodes, plot, items, puzzles, deaths), even when you think you know the answer.

consulta.description: keywords: full names and the topic, e.g. Glenn Rhee TV Series death

function.name: temperatura_do_mac
function.description: Reads the temperature of the Mac's CPU and GPU. The result already says whether it's normal, hot or very hot for the Mac.

function.name: temperatura_do_pc
function.description: Reads the temperature of the PC's GPU (the GTX 1060). The result already says whether it's normal, hot or very hot for that card.
